title: Herrera spoke to Kirk McConnell in a SCIF

tellings.quote: I know. I know. I talked to him in a skiff.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels that he talked to a man named Kirk McConnell inside a SCIF, a sealed room in Washington used for discussing classified information. He says it briefly, as something he did himself, to show that his account was heard in a classified setting.
